title: The Dragon's Riddle
claude_note: Claude communicates via THOUGHT BUBBLES - his thoughts are narrated by the Narrator voice, not spoken directly

scenes.title: Meeting the Dragon
scenes.setting: Rocky mountain plateau with ancient dragon resting peacefully

lines.text: High atop the misty mountain, Sir James and Claude discovered something extraordinary - a wise old dragon resting on sun-warmed rocks.
Claude's nose twitched. He could smell something magical in the air!
Hello, great dragon! I am Sir James, and this is my loyal friend Claude. We come seeking wisdom.
Sunlight danced through the leaves, creating patterns of gold and shadow.
The dragon opened one golden eye and smiled. 'A young knight with a pure heart. How refreshing! I have a riddle for you.'
Sir James took a deep breath, feeling brave.

scenes.title: The First Riddle
scenes.setting: Dragon's cave entrance with ancient runes glowing

lines.text: The dragon led them to a cave entrance where ancient runes glowed with soft golden light.
Claude let out a soft woof of support. He believed in his young knight.
What is your riddle, wise dragon? I promise to think carefully before I answer.
The moment felt special, like the beginning of something important.
The dragon's voice rumbled like distant thunder. 'What is stronger than steel, yet cannot be seen? What binds hearts together, yet sets spirits free?'
Sir James took a deep breath, feeling brave.
Sir James sat in a meadow of wildflowers, thinking deeply about the riddle. Claude rested his head on James's lap.
Claude wagged his tail, sensing the adventure ahead.
What do you think, Claude? Something stronger than steel but invisible... something that binds but also frees...
Everything seemed to hold its breath in anticipation.
Claude's tail wagged gently, and Sir James felt the warmth of their friendship. Suddenly, he understood!
Sir James felt a warm glow of courage in his heart.

scenes.title: The Answer
scenes.setting: Back at the dragon's plateau, sunset colors

lines.text: Sir James returned to the dragon as the sun painted the sky in brilliant oranges and purples.
Claude tilted his head thoughtfully. His loyal heart was ready for anything.
I know the answer, wise dragon! It is a promise - honor and trust! A promise binds hearts together, yet when kept, it sets our spirits free!
The world around them felt alive with wonder.
The dragon's eyes sparkled with delight. 'Well done, young knight! You have wisdom beyond your years.'
Sir James felt proud to be on this adventure.

scenes.title: The Dragon's Gift
scenes.setting: Dragon presenting a glowing scale to Sir James

lines.text: The dragon reached beneath his wing and pulled out a single golden scale that glowed with inner light.
Claude stayed close to Sir James, his faithful eyes full of encouragement.
For me? Oh, thank you, wise dragon! I will treasure this always and remember your lesson about honor.
The world around them felt alive with wonder.
The scale was warm in Sir James's hand, a reminder that keeping promises makes us stronger than any armor.
Sir James nodded thoughtfully, considering his options.

scenes.title: A Promise Made
scenes.setting: Sir James and Claude with the dragon, making a vow

lines.text: Before leaving, Sir James placed his hand over his heart and looked up at the great dragon.
Claude's nose twitched. He could smell something magical in the air!
I promise to always keep my word, to be honorable and true. This I vow as a knight!
Nature itself seemed to be watching, curious about what would happen next.
The dragon nodded wisely. 'A promise made with a pure heart is the most powerful magic of all.'
Sir James remembered Gramps's wise words.

scenes.title: The Journey Down
scenes.setting: Mountain path with Sir James and Claude descending

lines.text: As Sir James and Claude made their way down the mountain, the golden scale glowed softly in his pocket.
Claude let out a soft woof of support. He believed in his young knight.
You know what, Claude? Being honorable isn't just about big promises. It's about keeping the small ones too.
Nature itself seemed to be watching, curious about what would happen next.
Claude barked in agreement, and together they walked toward home, their hearts full of new understanding.
Sir James's eyes widened with wonder.

scenes.title: Gramps's Pride
scenes.setting: Home at sunset, Gramps waiting at the gate

lines.text: As they reached home, Gramps was waiting at the garden gate, his eyes twinkling with knowing pride.
Claude's ears perked up with curiosity. Something exciting was about to happen!
Gramps! I met a dragon and learned about honor! A promise is stronger than steel!
The air seemed to shimmer with possibility.
Claude wagged his tail happily as Gramps embraced Sir James, proud of the young knight's growing wisdom.
That's right, my boy. A true knight's word is his bond. I'm so proud of you.

virtue_choice.prompt: What should Sir James do next?

options.text: Take a moment to reflect on what was learned.

questions: What did Sir James learn about keeping promises and being honorable in this chapter?
How did Claude help Sir James during the adventure?
What would you have done if you were Sir James?
Can you think of a time when you showed similar courage/kindness/wisdom?
